scene.start_anchor: “Next!” I ordered. I did not at first bother to look up from the desktop
scene.context_summary: Customs and Immigration Officer Krrkktnkk a’ktnnzzik’tk encounters an "Unknown Species" abductee named Kevin Jenkins. Jenkins, a small, dense-seeming biped, introduces himself as Abductee 907-42-96-53-3. The officer learns that Jenkins is a "Human" from a "deathworld" and has been abducted by the Corti, causing bureaucratic issues due to the Galactic Treaty of Laws.
scene.time_indicators: interstellar convenient standard date/time 1196-5-24.4; two standard Diurnals

scene.start_anchor: I was interrupted by an alarm. Three short howls of noise—the attack alarm.
scene.context_summary: An attack alarm sounds on Civilian trade station 591 ‘Outlook on Forever,’ interrupting Officer Krrkktnkk's interview with Kevin Jenkins. The station is violently attacked by "Hunters," carnivorous aliens who hunt sentient beings. Jenkins, despite being shot multiple times, proves remarkably resilient and brutally kills the Hunters, saving Krrkktnkk's life.
scene.time_indicators: No explicit time indicators, but directly follows the previous scene.
scene.break_reason: The narrative shifts abruptly from a bureaucratic interview to an unexpected and violent alien attack on the station, introducing immediate physical danger and action.

scene.start_anchor: I found the human Kevin Jenkins in conversation with one of the station’s senior lawyers on the public promenade deck.
scene.context_summary: Weeks after the Hunter attack, the officer, now with a prosthetic arm, meets Kevin Jenkins again. Jenkins is discussing his petition to reclassify humans as sentient. They discuss human biology, strength, and resilience, which astonishes the officer and Lawyer Vedreg. Jenkins also reveals the deeply troubling concept of "Religion" on Earth, a subject that alarms both aliens.
scene.time_indicators: three groups of eight standard diurnals; twenty diurnals after the attack; half my life; very young age
scene.break_reason: There is a significant time jump and a complete change of setting from the immediate aftermath of the attack to a later, calmer discussion about human nature and legal status.

scene.start_anchor: In hindsight, I really should have expected that Jenkins would have attracted a journalist’s attention.
scene.context_summary: Jenkins' conversation about religion quickly goes viral on interstellar newsfeeds, leading to a special council meeting and a civilian fleet's disastrous first contact attempt with Earth. This prompts the council to amend the Galactic Treaty of Laws and launch a covert surveillance mission to Earth, with the officer transferred and promoted to head of security on the research station. Jenkins and two other human abductees, Charlotte and Jung, join the mission.
scene.time_indicators: Within hours; Three diurnals later; five eight-diurnals after the mission was announced; once every eight-diurnals
scene.break_reason: The narrative shifts from a private conversation to galactic-level political and military actions, a significant time jump, and a new mission setting focused on Earth observation.

scene.start_anchor: We spent a lot of time monitoring the political situation at first.
scene.context_summary: On the stealth research station orbiting Earth, the crew, including the officer, observes human culture. The officer, initially guided by Jenkins' pessimistic view, discovers the profound beauty and complexity of human art, philosophy, and pastimes, despite their internal conflicts, particularly regarding religion. The officer concludes that humans are "tortured geniuses" who thrive on adversity and must never learn of their true superiority to other species, as it might break them.
scene.time_indicators: a lot of time; nearly a full diurnal; once every eight-diurnals; Up until that point
scene.break_reason: This scene focuses on the long-term observation of Earth and the evolution of the officer's understanding of humanity, a distinct shift from the immediate political fallout and mission setup of the previous scene.
